description: This file defines a custom 'link' mark for a rich text editor, including its options, attributes, parsing, rendering, commands, input and paste rules, and ProseMirror plugins. It integrates linkifyjs for link detection and provides functionalities like autolinking, click handling, and paste handling for links within the editor.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: A custom Mark extension for handling links in the editor, including options for autolinking, protocols, click and paste handling, and commands for setting, toggling, and unsetting links.

methods.name: insertLink
methods.description: A helper function to insert or toggle a link mark with specified attributes, handling selection and existing marks.
